about.title: Building the Future,
about.description: Passionate fullstack engineer with a focus on scalable architecture and delightful user experiences.
about.mindsetTitle: Bridging Architecture Rigor with Modern User Experience
about.p1: I am Duong Nguyen, a Software Engineer graduated from Ho Chi Minh City University of Industry (IUH). My work is focused on creating dependable web ecosystems that solve real business problems without accumulating technical debt.
about.p2: Whether implementing Spring Boot microservices with asynchronous Kafka messaging or designing fluid React interfaces, I adhere strictly to SOLID principles, clean code patterns, and automated verification.
about.quote: Code is written once but read, debugged, and maintained hundreds of times. Production reliability and clarity always precede premature complexity.
about.onboardingSubtitle: Available full-time in Ho Chi Minh City / Remote

pillars.microservicesDesc: Independent services, event-driven Kafka pipelines, Docker containers, and robust database isolation.
pillars.springDesc: Clean layered architecture (Controller → Service → Repository), JWT auth, and optimized JPA queries.
pillars.frontendDesc: Responsive React 19 & Next.js user experiences, TanStack Query caching, and state predictability.
pillars.aiDesc: Seamlessly weaving Gemini AI, FastAPI models, and automated reporting into user-facing products.
